current_claim: An OSW-ready physical-availability and evidence challenge that accepts sponsor exports locally and makes zero network requests.
mechanism: A local static page ingests synthetic or sponsor-supplied exports and applies evidence and physical-availability challenge rules.

findings.title: The demonstrated evidence chain is still primarily synthetic.
findings.mechanism: The page proves local parsing and challenge behavior, but does not yet carry a representative, source-receipted corpus of ugly sponsor exports and incompatible field semantics.
findings.acceptance: Qualify multiple representative export families, preserve exact source hashes and parser dispositions, and retain malformed, contradictory, and unsupported examples.

findings.title: The actor and authority model is implicit.
findings.mechanism: The interface can classify evidence without an explicit matrix separating buyer observation, sponsor assertion, maintenance authority, acceptance authority, and operational custody.
findings.acceptance: Every finding identifies the actor, evidence source, decision authority, held external effect, and acceptance criterion.

findings.title: The browser proof does not establish a visual or interaction constitution.
findings.mechanism: Functional checks can pass while typography, compact-width behavior, keyboard order, help, and failure-state legibility degrade.
findings.acceptance: Add desktop and mobile light and dark goldens, typography fit tests, keyboard and touch playtests, and explicit import-failure screens.

next_gate: Replace synthetic sufficiency with a source-receipted multi-format intake campaign.
